referenceImages.name: Pink Hall, Mubarak Mandi
referenceImages.scope: Whole independently named Pink Hall, now housing the Dogra Art Museum, as a dated2012exterior: reported rectangular hall, five courtyard-facing arches and five reported columns, matching gateway and projecting jharokha windows. Separate MarbleHall, deorhis and other palace buildings remain separate; this member does not complete MubarakMandi.
